title: DEPHYRIER Conector (Workers Count Zero Three)
style: electro pulse 112 bpm trilingual EN ES FR DEPHYRIER signature ledger-tone connector-query workers-count cold synth bass clean kick spoken-bridge
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cursor on the wire ran the connector check
Two accounts on the table laid the workers out direct
Zero on one side three on the other shelf
zynmirror media-worker coreyai-api itself

[Pre-Chorus — Spanish]
Dos cuentas un nombre la verdad partida
(Two accounts one name the truth divided)
El conector no miente la lista decidida
(The connector does not lie the list is decided)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER zero three the count is clean
Deux comptes un MCP la liste est sereine
(Two accounts one MCP the list is serene)
Dos cuentas tres workers la cuenta cantada
(Two accounts three workers the count is sung)

[Verse 2]
zynthioai dot gmail held no worker at all
the other carried three behind the firewall
Not a guess not a vibe a tool reply read
Four nineteen nine twenty seven the timestamp said

[Bridge — French]
Le connecteur a parlé pas le pressentiment
(The connector spoke not the hunch)
Trois zéro la preuve dans le document
(Three zero the proof in the document)

[Outro — Trilingual]
zynmirror media coreyai trois
DEPHYRIER conector la prueba está
DEPHYRIER connector the proof is here
